title: Expected Run Value Pitch Recommender
description: An interactive baseball analytics project that recommends pitches using game count, base and out state, batter handedness, previous pitch, and the available pitch arsenal. It combines Statcast data with a reinforcement learning model and compares options by expected run value, whiff rate, MLB usage, and sample size. This project overlaps with my Eclipse Analytics baseball work and its pitch tunneling project website.
